description: An interface left behind after the hand is lost. It cannot restore your grip, but provides a mount for a prosthetic cannon. Installing it teaches the recipes for 'prosthetic arm cannon CBM' and 'arm cannon charge'. Activate the crafted cannon from your inventory to attach it yourself, without power or surgery.

A handmade mechanical arm cannon. With the lost left-hand interface installed, activate this item directly in your inventory to attach it yourself, even with your remaining hand occupied. Do not wield it to install it. No power, surgical equipment, or other materials are required. The item is consumed only after the prosthetic arm cannon bionic is successfully installed.
